_note: Every legal statement in NYAYMITRA must point at one of these sources. `retrieved_on`/`last_checked_at` are null wherever a human has not yet verified the record: the API and UI surface that gap instead of hiding it.

sources.title: The Constitution of India (as amended up to the 106th Amendment Act, 2023)
sources.publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
sources.document_ref: India Code — Constitution of India (full text, English)
sources.licence_note: Government of India publication; reproduced with attribution.
sources.notes: Canonical source for article numbering and statutory text. NOT retrieved in this environment (no outbound access to indiacode.nic.in). The project owner must supply the PDF/text; run scripts/ingest_constitution.py.

sources.title: The Constitution of India — Santhali (Ol Chiki) edition, first edition
sources.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice / National Translation Mission, CIIL Mysuru
sources.notes: This is the document the legacy importer read. It is NOT usable as the article corpus: chunk-level extraction produced bogus article numbers and a fabricated remedy field. Quarantined; see docs/REPOSITORY_AUDIT.md section 6 and data/legacy/LEGACY_DATA_NOTE.md.

sources.title: Project owner's citizen-facing Gujarati and English explanations
sources.notes: Human-written paraphrases, not statutory text. Any row using this source must be labelled owner_authored_summary and requires legal review before being described as law.

sources.title: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
sources.publisher: National Legal Services Authority, Government of India
sources.document_ref: NALSA portal — free legal aid, helpline 15100
sources.notes: Contact details must be re-checked by a human before being shown as verified.

sources.title: The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987
sources.publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
sources.document_ref: Act No. 39 of 1987, section 12 (criteria for free legal aid)
sources.notes: Section 12 sets out who is entitled to free legal services. Text not fetched in this environment.

sources.title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
sources.document_ref: Cyber crime incident reporting + financial-fraud helpline 1930
sources.notes: Helpline and reporting flow to be verified by a human.

sources.title: AnyRoR — Gujarat land records portal
sources.notes: Portal reachable by citizens; DILR measurement application is filed at the taluka office, not through this portal.

sources.title: Gujarat CM Helpline (1076) / state grievance system
sources.notes: Helpline number must be re-confirmed by a human before display as verified.

sources.title: CPGRAMS — Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System
sources.publisher: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances, Government of India
sources.notes: Used for grievances against central government departments; state issues normally go to the state portal.

sources.title: RTI Online
sources.publisher: Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India
sources.document_ref: Right to Information Act, 2005 request filing
sources.notes: Only for central public authorities; each state has its own RTI portal.

sources.title: e-Daakhil — consumer grievance filing
sources.publisher: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
sources.document_ref: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 — online complaint filing
sources.notes: Filing fee, jurisdiction and limitation period must be confirmed by a human.

sources.title: Tele-Law — legal advice through Common Service Centres
sources.publisher: Department of Justice, Government of India
sources.document_ref: Tele-Law service delivered via CSC centres
sources.notes: Availability depends on the local CSC; verify per district.

sources.title: Emergency Response Support System (112)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
sources.document_ref: Single emergency number for police, fire and ambulance
sources.notes: Number carried over from the legacy UI; page not fetched in this environment.

sources.title: Abhayam women's helpline (181), Gujarat
sources.publisher: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Gujarat
sources.notes: Carried over from the legacy UI and NOT independently confirmed. Kept because removing a functioning helpline would be worse than labelling it, but it must never be shown as verified.

sources.title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
sources.publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
sources.document_ref: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (in force from 1 July 2024)
sources.notes: Replaces the Indian Penal Code. Section numbering differs from the IPC; the legacy repository paired BNS 303 with IPC 379 and BNS 318 with IPC 420 without a source. Those pairings must be confirmed against this Act before display.
